title: Zero coordinate derivative formula
statement: For every real number $t$ and every point $x$ of the three-dimensional sign cube, the discrete derivative in coordinate $0$ of the function $F_t$ at $x$ is $(-s_1+s_2)/4$, where $s_j$ denotes the real sign value of coordinate $j$ of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a point of the three-dimensional sign cube
